guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 連結水理、電源、儲水與故障情境的抽水站整合。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Integrating pump hydraulics power storage and failure scenarios. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入流Qi=6、抽排Qp=4 m³/s、時間Δt=300 s、有效面積A=600 m²，水位升幅Δh=(Qi−Qp)Δt/A=1.00 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設靜揚程Hs=3.0 m、損失係數K=0.20 s²/m⁵、流量Q=4.0 m³/s，Hsys=Hs+KQ²=6.20 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單泵Hp=10−0.25q² m、系統Hs=3+0.20Q² m，q、Q以m³/s計；兩泵Q=2q得Q=2√(7/1.05)=5.164 m³/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Q=4 m³/s、H=6 m、ηp=0.75、ηm=0.95，P=ρgQH/(ηpηm)=330.44 kW，g=9.81 m/s²。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設轉速比N2/N1=0.90，相似點Q2/Q1=0.90、H2/H1=0.81、P2/P1=0.729。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設A=100 m²、啟停差Δh=0.60 m、Qi=0.50、Qp=2.0 m³/s；循環T=60/0.50+60/(2−0.50)=160 s，即22.5次/h。
factsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume inflow Qi=6, pumping Qp=4 m³/s, Δt=300 s and effective area A=600 m². Rise Δh=(Qi−Qp)Δt/A=1.00 m.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume static head Hs=3.0 m, loss coefficient K=0.20 s²/m⁵ and flow Q=4.0 m³/s. System head Hsys=Hs+KQ²=6.20 m.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pump Hp=10−0.25q² m and system Hs=3+0.20Q² m, with q,Q in m³/s. Two pumps give Q=2q=2√(7/1.05)=5.164 m³/s.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, Q=4 m³/s, H=6 m, ηp=0.75, ηm=0.95 and g=9.81 m/s². Input P=ρgQH/(ηpηm)=330.44 kW.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume speed ratio N2/N1=0.90. At homologous points Q2/Q1=0.90, H2/H1=0.81 and P2/P1=0.729.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume A=100 m², level band Δh=0.60 m, Qi=0.50 and Qp=2.0 m³/s. Cycle T=60/0.50+60/(2−0.50)=160 s, or 22.5 starts/h.

2012 — West Closure Complex first operates gates and pumping for a storm event.
2020 — The USACE official catalogue lists the updated pumping-station mechanical/electrical manual.

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：防洪抽水站機組整合
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Flood-pumping-station integration
guides.concept: 本課由內水收支與系統揚程進入並聯泵、效率、變速、啟停及吸入條件，再串接電源、閘門與備援能力。上環與西部封閉綜合工程提供不同尺度的實例，所有算例為原創簡化條件；課程要求可追溯驗證與失效界面分析，不將教學數字當現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: The course moves from interior-water balance and system head to parallel units, efficiency, speed, cycling and suction conditions, then integrates power, gates and retained capacity. Sheung Wan and the West Closure Complex provide examples at different scales. Every calculation is an original simplification, requiring traceable verification and interface analysis rather than treating lesson values as field operating settings.
procedure: 防洪抽水站處理的是隨時間進入低窪區的水量，而不是單一固定流量。外河高水位關閉重力出口時，集水池與上游管網共同儲存未排出的水，水位上升速度取決於淨入流和有效面積；抽水能力需要與降雨逕流、儲水曲線和外水位成組分析，不能只比較泵銘牌與最大入流。本例在短時間內固定面積和進出流量，假設沒有其他溢流或滲流；不是整場洪水演算，也未描述管網局部積水。
泵需要克服內外水面差與管路損失，外河或海潮升高會改變系統曲線並移動工作點。靜揚程可隨內水位上升而降低，但摩阻通常隨流量增加，兩者不能混成固定總揚程；不同閘門與出口狀態也會改變損失，需為代表工況建立一致的能量帳。本例用二次損失近似固定配置的系統曲線，係數帶有單位；不涵蓋氣塞、虹吸建立或瞬變逆流。
並聯泵在相同揚程下疊加流量，但共同管路的摩阻會隨總流量增加，因此加開第二台通常不會使站流量正好加倍。不同機組曲線、止回閥及局部損失還可能造成不均分流，甚至讓一台落在不利區域；整合時須同時解機組與系統曲線，而不是把型錄數字相加。以下兩台完全相同且均分流量，泵曲線與系統曲線均為教學二次式；沒有替代實機穩定區、效率及汽蝕檢查。
抽水的水力功率由流量和總揚程決定，馬達輸入還須考慮泵、傳動與電機效率。不同效率應對應各自能量邊界，不能重複扣同一損失；峰值功率、啟動需求與整場耗電又是不同問題，平均節能指標不足以代表防洪事件中的供電能力。本例泵與馬達效率分開且忽略其他輔機，計算穩態實功率；不包含啟動電流、功率因數或發電機瞬態容量。
幾何相同的泵在相似工況下，流量、揚程和軸功率可依轉速比例建立近似關係，適合檢查性能曲線變化。實際站的靜揚程不隨轉速縮放，因此新工作點未必位於相似點；效率、汽蝕與低速穩定區也可能改變，不能把轉速平方或立方律直接當成整站保證。本例假設同一葉輪與近似相同效率，僅比較相似點；實際抽排量必須再與未同比縮放的系統曲線求交。
單台泵的啟停水位差形成可用調節容積，能減少頻繁啟動，但過大水位帶可能占用防洪儲量或降低淹沒裕度。填充與抽降時間分別受入流及淨抽出量控制，不可只用池容積除以泵流量；多台輪替、變入流與感測遲延會讓實際循環更複雜。本例為一台泵、固定池面積與固定入流，且抽排大於入流；算得啟動頻率只是比較，不是設備允許值或現場設定。
抽水站入口須同時滿足壓力裕度與均勻流場，池水位足夠也可能因不對稱入流而產生渦流與捲氣。淨正吸入水頭取決於大氣壓、吸入水位、蒸氣壓及損失，設備需求又隨流量和轉速變動；整合多台機組時應檢查不同組合造成的流場，不能只驗證全開狀態。下式各項均以同一淡水密度的水頭表示，水面高於泵參考取正；正差值不保證沒有渦流、捲氣或其他吸入問題。
備援電源須供應泵、控制和輔機，實功率與視在功率是不同容量約束，功率因數不能被效率取代。機組啟動時的電流與電壓暫降可能決定可行組合，即使連續千瓦需求足夠也不代表能順利啟動；燃料、冷卻及淹水隔離另影響可維持的事件時間。本例只換算平衡穩態負載的視在功率，不提供發電機選型容量；啟動、諧波及備援輔機需求尚未加入。
外水高於內水時，重力出口可能成為倒灌通道，閘門和止回構件的作用必須與抽排路徑協調。兩側水壓的差額決定部分靜水載荷，但實際關閉還涉及摩擦、浮物、動水與機構力；把閘門關閉訊號當成水密保證，會掩蓋漏水或位置感測錯誤。本例為同底高程直立矩形門兩側靜水合力差，不含動水與摩擦，也不直接給出致動器推力或關閉時機。
備援台數只有在實際揚程、電源和管路條件下才有意義，保留一台泵不代表任何故障都能維持完整排水。多台可能共用變壓器、閘門、攔污設備或控制，因此機械可用性不等於整站可用性；故障情境應把剩餘排量與儲水時間一起評估，並辨認共因失效。本例每台排量已指定為相同實際揚程下的可用量，假設停機不改變其他台工作點；真實並聯工況須重新求解。
procedureEn: A flood station handles a time-varying inflow rather than one fixed discharge. When high receiving water closes a gravity outlet, the sump and upstream network store unremoved water; rise rate depends on net inflow and effective surface area. Pumping must be evaluated with runoff, storage curves and receiving stage rather than merely comparing nameplate capacity with peak inflow. The short-step example fixes area and flows and excludes other overflow or seepage. It is neither full-event routing nor a description of local network flooding.

A pump overcomes the difference between interior and receiving surfaces plus hydraulic losses. Rising river or tide shifts the system curve and operating point. Static head can decrease as the sump rises, while friction generally increases with flow; they cannot be collapsed into one fixed total head. Gate and outlet states also require separate, consistent energy balances. The example uses a quadratic loss approximation for a fixed configuration, with a dimensional coefficient. It excludes trapped air, siphon establishment and transient reverse flow.

Parallel pumps add flow at a common head, but shared-pipe friction grows with total flow, so a second pump generally does not double station discharge. Different unit curves, check valves and local losses can create uneven sharing or an unfavorable operating region. Integration therefore solves pump and system curves together rather than adding catalog values. The two units are identical and share flow equally, with hypothetical quadratic pump and system curves. This does not replace real-machine stability, efficiency or cavitation checks.

Hydraulic power follows flow and total head, while motor input includes pump, transmission and electrical efficiencies. Each efficiency must correspond to a distinct energy boundary so losses are not counted twice. Peak power, starting demand and event energy are separate questions; a mean energy metric does not establish electrical adequacy during a flood. Pump and motor efficiencies are separate and auxiliary loads are excluded. The result is steady real power, not starting current, power factor or generator transient capacity.

For a geometrically unchanged pump at homologous conditions, flow, head and shaft power approximately scale with speed, supporting a curve-shift check. Station static head does not scale with speed, so the new operating point need not be homologous. Efficiency, cavitation and low-speed stability may change, preventing direct use of square or cube laws as station-wide guarantees. The example assumes one impeller and approximately unchanged efficiency and compares homologous points only. Actual discharge requires intersecting the shifted pump curve with the system curve.

The start-stop level band creates regulating volume that can reduce repeated starts, but an excessive band may consume flood storage or reduce submergence margin. Filling and drawdown depend on inflow and net pumping respectively, not simply volume divided by pump flow. Multiple-unit rotation, variable inflow and sensing delay further complicate actual cycling. The example uses one pump, constant area and inflow, with pumping exceeding inflow. Its start frequency is a comparison, not an equipment limit or field setting.

Pump inlets need both pressure margin and acceptable flow quality; adequate depth can still coexist with vortices from asymmetric inflow. Available NPSH depends on atmospheric pressure, sump level, vapor pressure and losses, while required NPSH varies with flow and speed. Integrating several units requires checking different combinations rather than testing only all-units-on operation. All terms are freshwater heads on one density basis, with surface above the pump reference positive. A positive margin does not guarantee absence of vortices, air entrainment or other inlet problems.

Backup supply serves pumps, controls and auxiliaries. Real and apparent power impose different constraints, and power factor is not efficiency. Starting current and voltage dip can determine feasible combinations even when continuous kilowatts appear adequate. Fuel, cooling and flood isolation separately influence how long the station can continue through an event. The example converts a balanced steady load to apparent power only, not generator selection capacity. Starting, harmonics and backup auxiliary demand remain excluded.

When receiving water exceeds interior stage, a gravity outlet can become a backflow path, requiring coordination of gates and check devices with pumping routes. Differential hydrostatic pressure supplies part of the static load, but closure also involves friction, debris, moving water and actuator forces. A closed indication is not proof of watertightness or correct position sensing. The example is the difference in hydrostatic resultants on a vertical rectangular gate with a common bottom datum. It excludes flow and friction and does not specify actuator force or closure timing.

Spare-unit counts matter only at actual head, electrical and pipe conditions. One spare does not preserve full drainage for every fault. Units can share a transformer, gate, screen or controller, so mechanical availability is not station availability. Failure scenarios should compare retained flow with storage time and identify common causes across the complete system. Each unit’s stated flow is available at the same actual head, and an outage is assumed not to shift other operating points. Real parallel-system performance must be solved again.
evidence: 建立五分鐘體積帳並逐步更新池水位，讓其中一段抽排量降低。指出峰值入流比較與全事件體積演算各會發現什麼問題，並標記需要水位面積曲線的區段。
畫出兩種外水位的系統曲線，保持管路損失係數不變。說明曲線移動如何影響與泵曲線的交點，再列出哪些構件改變會使係數也必須更新。
先解單台交點，再解兩台交點並比較增加比例。將一台泵曲線稍微下移，說明均分流量假設為何不再成立，以及需要補量測哪個支路。
畫出電表、馬達軸與水流三個能量邊界，將效率放在正確位置。比較泵效率下降而其他條件固定時的輸入功率，再指出啟動分析尚缺的電氣資料。
畫出含靜揚程與不含靜揚程兩條系統曲線，比較同一降速泵曲線的交點。指出相似點與實際工作點的差別，避免把兩種比例放在同一張效益表。
evidenceEn: Build a five-minute volume ledger with sequential stage updates and reduce pumping during one interval. Explain the different problems revealed by peak-flow comparison and full-event volume routing, marking where a stage-area curve becomes necessary.

Draw system curves for two receiving stages while holding the loss coefficient fixed. Explain their changed intersections with the pump curve, then identify component changes that would also require updating the coefficient.

Solve single- and two-pump intersections and compare the increase. Shift one pump curve downward slightly, explaining why equal sharing then fails and which branch measurements would be needed to determine the new distribution.

Draw meter, motor-shaft and water-flow energy boundaries with efficiencies at the correct interfaces. Compare input power after reduced pump efficiency at fixed conditions, then identify electrical information still missing for a starting analysis.

Draw system curves with and without static head and compare intersections with one reduced-speed pump curve. Distinguish homologous points from operating points so their ratios are not mixed in a performance table.
pitfalls: 只用最大泵量而忽略高外水位的實際工況會高估抽排，漏掉上游管網蓄水則可能錯估池水位變化；淨入流長時間為正時，有限儲量終究會耗盡。
直接把單台工況流量乘台數會忽略共同摩阻，異型泵也可能出現分流失衡；名義總容量足夠時，某台仍可能偏離允許運轉區而增加振動或過熱。
直接宣稱降速一成必節電百分之二十七點一，會忽略新工作點和效率改變；靜揚程較大時，低速泵可能無法克服外水位而幾乎沒有抽排。
只以池水深推定無汽蝕會忽略入口損失與溫度，某些機組停用後也可能產生偏流；入口整流改善一種組合時，未必同時改善其他組合。
只算外側三角水壓會漏掉內側抵銷，誤用水位差平方則不能代替兩水深平方差；關閉回饋失真或漂流物夾住時，抽水站仍可能持續承受倒灌。
pitfallsEn: Using maximum pump flow without the high-tailwater operating point overstates drainage. Omitting upstream network storage distorts sump response, and persistently positive net inflow eventually exhausts finite available storage.

Multiplying a single-unit operating flow by unit count ignores shared friction, and dissimilar pumps may share unevenly. Even with adequate nominal total capacity, an individual unit can leave its acceptable range and experience vibration or overheating.

Claiming a guaranteed 27.1-percent saving from a ten-percent speed reduction ignores the changed operating point and efficiency. With substantial static head, a slower pump may barely overcome receiving water and provide little drainage.

Inferring cavitation freedom from depth alone ignores entrance losses and temperature. Idle units can change approach symmetry, and an intake modification improving one combination may not improve all other operating combinations.

Using only outside pressure omits interior opposition, while squaring the level difference cannot replace the difference of squared depths. False closed feedback or trapped debris can leave a backflow path despite the station’s indicated state.

related.title: 河川水位自動遙測
related.transfer: 可遷移「內水蓄積與抽排收支機理與驗證」與「吸入工況與流場品質機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；河川水位自動遙測的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦連結水理、電源、儲水與故障情境的抽水站整合；河川水位自動遙測則以把水位感測、時間與發布品質連成可追溯資料鏈為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on integrating pump hydraulics power storage and failure scenarios; Automatic river-level telemetry centres on connecting stage sensing, timing and publication quality into a traceable chain, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「內水蓄積與抽排收支」與「測站基準與水面高程」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到河川水位自動遙測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「上升速率與雜訊機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Interior storage and pumping balance” and “Gage datum and water elevation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Automatic river-level telemetry, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rise-rate estimation and noise mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.title: 防洪抽水站機組整合
history.text: 上環雨水抽水站於2009年啟用，業主說明其地下儲水、閘門和抽水共同處理低窪區與潮水問題。西部封閉綜合工程於2012年八月首次為風暴事件關閉閘門並操作抽水，提供大型外水阻隔與內水排除的比較。香港2018年雨水手冊涵蓋防洪抽水設施，工兵團官方目錄則確認2020年機電設計手冊版本。本課核對的是這些歷史與技術範圍，沒有將舊版同名PDF誤稱新版全文，也沒有推定任何列名工程使用假設泵曲線。
history.textEn: Sheung Wan was commissioned in 2009; its owner describes underground storage, gates and pumps addressing low ground and tidal backflow. The West Closure Complex first closed gates and pumped for a storm event in August 2012, providing a larger-scale comparison of exterior protection and interior drainage. Hong Kong’s 2018 drainage manual covers flood pumping, and the USACE official catalogue confirms its 2020 mechanical/electrical manual edition. These historical facts and scopes were checked without mislabeling an older same-named PDF as the new full text or attributing hypothetical pump curves to either project.
